1	/-

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamily
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FlatCokernel
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafDatumBaseChange
9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeH1BaseChange
10	
11	/-!
12	# Base change of certified divisor families (the DD-1 stage (c) pullback,
13	`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c))
14	
15	Along a test-ring change `R → R'` (a `k`-algebra map, packaged as `[Algebra R R']`
16	`[IsScalarTower k R R']`), a certified divisor family over `R` pulls back to one over
17	`R'` through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C R R'`. This file builds
18	the geometric half of that pullback — the cover data and adaptation push forward through
19	the sections comparison `relSectionsMap` (`Scheme.Hom.appLE`), pieces to pieces
20	(`relSectionsMap_basicOpen`), partitions by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one` — and prepares
21	the certificate transport that turns it into `DivFam.mapAlg` — which is LANDED in
22	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMapAlg` (this file remains its geometric feeder).
23	
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.baseChange` — the `Fin`-indexed cover data pushes
25	  forward: generators/partition coefficients go through `relSectionsMap`, the partition
26	  witnesses by ring-hom functoriality (the `Fin`-indexed mirror of
27	  `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange`).
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.pieces_baseChange` — pieces base-change to pieces
29	  (`relSectionsMap_basicOpen`): `(D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j`.
30	
31	The module structures are the local instances of the DD-1 carrier (`Scheme.overModule`,
32	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`, house rule); the mixed `relCurve`/product spellings force
33	`backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false`, as in `RelativeSectionsLinear`.
34	-/
35	
36	set_option autoImplicit false
37	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling
38	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
39	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
40	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
41	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
42	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
43	
44	universe u
45	
46	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TopologicalSpace
47	open Opposite TensorProduct
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
52	
53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
54	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
55	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
56	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
57	
58	/-! ## The cover data base change -/
59	
60	namespace FinCoverData
61	
62	variable (D : FinCoverData C R π)
63	
64	/-- **Base change of the `Fin`-indexed cover data** along `R → R'`: the generators and
65	partition coefficients push forward through the sections comparison `relSectionsMap`; the
66	partition witnesses are carried by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one` (the `Fin`-indexed mirror
67	of `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange`). -/
68	noncomputable def baseChange : FinCoverData C R' π where
69	  m₀ := D.m₀
70	  m₁ := D.m₁
71	  h₀ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
72	  h₁ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
73	  a₀ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.a₀ j)
74	  a₁ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.a₁ j)
75	  partition₀ := by
76	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π)) D.partition₀
77	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
78	    rw [← h]
79	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
80	  partition₁ := by
81	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π)) D.partition₁
82	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
83	    rw [← h]
84	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
85	
86	@[simp]
87	lemma baseChange_h₀ (j : Fin D.m₀) :
88	    (D.baseChange R').h₀ j = relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j) := rfl
89	
90	@[simp]
91	lemma baseChange_h₁ (j : Fin D.m₁) :
92	    (D.baseChange R').h₁ j = relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j) := rfl
93	
94	/-- **Pieces base-change to pieces**: the pieces of the base-changed cover data are the
95	`relCurveMap`-preimages of the pieces (`relSectionsMap_basicOpen`). -/
96	theorem pieces_baseChange (j : D.index) :
97	    (D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j := by
98	  cases j with
99	  | inl j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
100	  | inr j => exact relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)
101	
102	/-- The base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the pieces (the `≤`-form of
103	`pieces_baseChange` consumed by `appLE`). -/
104	lemma baseChange_pieces_le_preimage (j : D.index) :
105	    (D.baseChange R').pieces j ≤ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j :=
106	  (D.pieces_baseChange R' j).le
107	
108	/-- Double overlaps of base-changed pieces are below the preimages of the double
109	overlaps. -/
110	lemma baseChange_inf_le_preimage (i j : D.index) :
111	    (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j ≤
112	      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) := by
113	  rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
114	  exact inf_le_inf (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' i)
115	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' j)
116	
117	end FinCoverData
118	
119	/-! ## The chart-ring base change, as an algebra equivalence
120	
121	`relTermBaseChange` is the `R'`-linear base change of chart sections; on the chart charts
122	it is in fact multiplicative (the underlying map `r' ⊗ y ↦ r' • relSectionsMap y` is a
123	ring homomorphism because `relSectionsMap` is), so it promotes to an `R'`-algebra
124	equivalence. This is the ring-level input to the piece-level term identification (the
125	away-localization base change of `IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight`). -/
126	
127	/-- **The chart-ring base change**, as an `R'`-algebra equivalence
128	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`: the promotion of the `R'`-linear
129	`relTermBaseChange` (multiplicative because `relSectionsMap` is a ring homomorphism). -/
130	noncomputable def relTermBaseChangeAlg (V : C.left.Opens)
131	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
132	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃ₐ[R']
133	      Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
134	  AlgEquiv.ofLinearEquiv (relTermBaseChange C R R' V hV hV')
135	    (by
136	      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, relTermBaseChange_tmul, one_smul, map_one])
137	    (by
138	      intro x y
139	      induction x with
140	      | zero => rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
141	      | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx₁, hx₂, map_add, add_mul]
142	      | tmul a s =>
143	        induction y with
144	        | zero => rw [mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
145	        | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy₁, hy₂, map_add, mul_add]
146	        | tmul b t =>
147	          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, relTermBaseChange_tmul,
148	            relTermBaseChange_tmul, relTermBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, smul_mul_smul_comm])
149	
150	@[simp]
151	lemma relTermBaseChangeAlg_tmul (V : C.left.Opens)
152	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
153	    (r' : R') (y : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
154	    relTermBaseChangeAlg (R := R) R' V hV hV' (r' ⊗ₜ y) = r' • relSectionsMap C R R' V y :=
155	  relTermBaseChange_tmul C R R' hV hV' r' y
156	
157	/-! ## The piece-level term identification (the certificate linchpin)
158	
159	For a section `h` of an affine chart `V_R`, the piece `D(h)` sections are the away
160	localization of `Γ(V_R)` at `h`; base change commutes with this localization, so
161	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'))` where `h' = relSectionsMap h`. This is the
162	`IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight` base change transported along the
163	chart-ring iso `relTermBaseChangeAlg`. -/
164	
165	section Piece
166	
167	variable (V : C.left.Opens)
168	variable (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
169	variable (hVaff : IsAffineOpen ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
170	variable (hVaff' : IsAffineOpen ((fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
171	variable (h : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
172	
173	/-- The `R`-to-piece scalar tower: the structure map `R → Γ(D(h))` factors through the
174	chart ring `Γ(V_R)`. -/
175	lemma isScalarTower_R_chart_piece :
176	    IsScalarTower R Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
177	      Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) := by
178	  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => ?_
179	  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra, Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra]
180	  exact ((relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap_apply_res R
181	    (homOfLE ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le h)).op r).symm
182	
183	/-- (Implementation) The `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)`-algebra structure on the base-changed piece
184	sections `Γ(D(h'))`, `h' = relSectionsMap h`: scalars act through the chart-ring iso
185	`relTermBaseChangeAlg` followed by restriction to the piece. Named (rather than a `letI`
186	inside `pieceTermBaseChangeAlg`) so that the computation rule
187	`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul` can re-enter the same instance context. -/
188	@[reducible]
189	noncomputable def pieceTensorChartAlgebra :
190	    Algebra (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
191	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
192	  ((algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
193	    Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))).comp
194	      (relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV').toAlgHom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
195	
196	/-- **The piece-level term identification** (the certificate linchpin,
197	`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c), "localization commutes with base change at the
198	pieces"): base change of the piece sections `Γ(D(h))` is the piece sections of the
199	base-changed generator, `R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'))` with `h' = relSectionsMap h`.
200	Assembled from the away-localization base change
201	`IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight` (source is `Away (1 ⊗ h)` over
202	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)`) transported along the chart-ring iso `relTermBaseChangeAlg`
203	(sending `1 ⊗ h ↦ h'`), which exhibits `Γ(D(h'))` as the same away localization. -/
204	noncomputable def pieceTermBaseChangeAlg :
205	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ≃ₐ[R']
206	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
207	  haveI := isScalarTower_R_chart_piece (R := R) V h
208	  haveI hLoc : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) :=
209	    hVaff.isLocalization_basicOpen h
210	  haveI hLoc' : IsLocalization.Away (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
211	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
212	    hVaff'.isLocalization_basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
213	  -- the base-ring iso, and the fact that it carries `1 ⊗ h` to `h'`
214	  set e := relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV' with he
215	  have heh : e ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h) = relSectionsMap C R R' V h := by
216	    rw [he, relTermBaseChangeAlg_tmul, one_smul]
217	  -- exhibit `Γ(D(h'))` as the away localization of `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)` at `1 ⊗ h`
218	  letI algPK : Algebra (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
219	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
220	    pieceTensorChartAlgebra R' V hV hV' h
221	  haveI hLocPK : IsLocalization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)
222	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
223	    refine IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left e.toRingEquiv
224	      (M₂ := Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
225	      ?_ (fun x => rfl) (M₁ := Submonoid.powers (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
226	    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
227	    exact congrArg Submonoid.powers heh
228	  -- the `R'`-scalar towers for `restrictScalars`
229	  haveI tR' : IsScalarTower R' Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
230	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
231	    isScalarTower_R_chart_piece (R := R') V (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
232	  haveI : IsScalarTower R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
233	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
234	    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r' => ?_
235	    change _ = algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) _
236	      (e (algebraMap R' _ r'))
237	    rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
238	  -- the two localizations of `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)` at `1 ⊗ h` are algebra-equivalent
239	  exact (IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight R R' h
240	    Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)).trans
241	    ((IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
242	      (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
243	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))).restrictScalars R')
244	
245	/-! ## Naturality of the piece-level term identification -/
246	
247	/-- The scheme-level piece-sections comparison along `R → R'`: `appLE` of the
248	relative-curve comparison from the piece `D(h)` to the base-changed piece `D(h')`,
249	`h' = relSectionsMap h` (the inclusion is `relSectionsMap_basicOpen`). This is the map
250	the piece-level term identification computes on `1 ⊗ s`
251	(`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`). -/
252	noncomputable def pieceSectionsMap :
253	    Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) →+*
254	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
255	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE ((relCurve C R).basicOpen h)
256	    ((relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
257	    (relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' V h).le).hom
258	
259	/-- The piece-sections comparison restricted along the chart algebra maps is the chart
260	comparison: `pieceSectionsMap (algebraMap a) = algebraMap (relSectionsMap a)` (both
261	algebra maps are the chart-to-piece restrictions; `Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
262	lemma pieceSectionsMap_algebraMap (a : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
263	    pieceSectionsMap R' V h
264	        (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
265	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a) =
266	      algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)

328	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)

363	
364	/-- The piece-level term identification carries the extended span of a set of
365	equations to the span of the compared equations (`Ideal.map_span` +
366	`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`); the `hIJ` input of the colength transport. -/
367	lemma pieceSpan_map_eq (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
368	    Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E) =
369	      ((Ideal.span E).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := R')
370	        (B := Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)))).map
371	        (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h : _ →+* _) := by
372	  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
373	  exact congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_congr fun s _ =>
374	    (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h s).symm)
375	
376	/-- **Base change of a quotient of piece sections** (the colength transport,
377	`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c)): for a set `E` of equations on the piece `D(h)`,
378	`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(D(h)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h')) ⧸ (E')` where `h' = relSectionsMap h` and `E'`
379	is the image of `E` under the piece-sections comparison. Quotient right-exactness
380	(`Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv`) followed by transport along the
381	piece-level term identification (`Ideal.quotientEquivAlg`; the span is carried by the
382	naturality rule `pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`). At `E = {f}` this is the chart-local
383	colength transport; at the two-element `E` it is the overlap-colength transport. -/
384	noncomputable def pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg
385	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
386	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
387	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) ⧸
388	        Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E) :=
389	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv R' Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)
390	    R' (Ideal.span E)).trans
391	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h)

397	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))
398	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
399	    pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h E
400	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =

406	        (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s)) := rfl
407	  rw [h1, pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul]

9	# Certificate transport for base change of divisor adaptations (DD-1 stage (c))
10	
11	For a divisor adaptation `A` over the test ring `R` and a test-ring change `R → R'`,
12	this file base-changes the whole colength apparatus — the pulled equations, chart-local
13	and overlap colengths, the two `δ`-arrows, and the glued equalizer module `W(d)` — and
14	transports the certificate clauses (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §1c):
15	
16	* `DivisorAdaptation.pulledEqn`/`pulledColength`/`pulledOvlIdeal`/`pulledOvlColength`/
17	  `pulledChartProd`/`pulledOvlProd`/`pulledDeltaLeft`/`pulledDeltaRight`/
18	  `pulledGluedSubmodule` — the raw `R'`-side colength apparatus on the base-changed
19	  pieces (definitionally the apparatus of the base-changed adaptation, once its
20	  refinement witness is supplied).
21	* `DivisorAdaptation.colengthBaseChange`/`ovlColengthBaseChange` — the chart-local and
22	  overlap colength transports `R' ⊗[R] colength ≃ₐ[R'] pulledColength`
23	  (instantiations of `pieceQuotBaseChange`/`ovlQuotBaseChange` at the equation ideals),
24	  with the (c1) clause transports `finite_pulledColength`/`projective_pulledColength`.
25	* `DivisorAdaptation.delta_baseChange_comm` — **`δ`-naturality**: the pulled difference
26	  arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product transports
27	  `chartProdBaseChange`/`ovlProdBaseChange`.
28	
29	The glued-module transport (clauses (c2)–(c4)) rides these in
30	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyPullbackGlued`.

/-! ## The `K`-algebra of sections of a scheme over `K` -/

section SectionsAlgebra

variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The `K`-algebra structure on `Γ(X, V)` for a scheme over `Spec K`: restriction of
scalars along the landed structure map `Scheme.overAlgebraMap`.  Deliberately **not** a
global instance (it would overlap with mathlib's `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instances through
the tautological `OverClass X X`; cf. the house rule for `Scheme.overModule`).  Activate
with `attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`; the `finrank` statements of
this file mention it, so consumers must activate the same instance. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra (V : X.Opens) :
    Algebra K Γ(X, V) :=
  (X.overAlgebraMap K V).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

/-- Unfolding lemma: the algebra structure map of `Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` is the landed
`Scheme.overAlgebraMap`. -/
lemma Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra (V : X.Opens) :
    algebraMap K Γ(X, V) = X.overAlgebraMap K V :=
  rfl

/-- The structure map `K →+* Γ(X, V)` is of finite type on an affine chart of a scheme
locally of finite type over `K`. -/
theorem Scheme.overAlgebraMap_finiteType
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] {V : X.Opens}

    rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
    rfl

    ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hV le_top)
    (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
      (((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv).mp inferInstance).surjective))

/-! ## PROBE 3: the WIDENED section-level keystone on an arbitrary affine open -/

section Probe3

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']

/-- PROBE: the raw pushout square of section rings for an ARBITRARY affine open `V` of
`relCurve C R` (no chart, no basic open, no partition of unity). -/
theorem probe_isPushout_relSections {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
      ((snd C (overSpec k R)).left.appLE ⊤ V
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R)).left).ge))
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).ge)
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
      ((snd C (overSpec k R')).left.appLE ⊤ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R')).left).ge)) := by
  have hUST : (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) ≤
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')) ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUSX : V ≤ (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUY : relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V =
      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓
        (snd C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (probe_isPullback_relCurveMap C R R')
    hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k R) (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k R') hV
  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h

/-- PROBE: the algebra-corner form. -/
theorem probe_isPushout_algebraMap_relSections {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(relCurve C R, V)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R')).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k R')).left.appLE ⊤ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R')).left).ge)) := by
  refine (probe_isPushout_relSections C R R' hV).of_iso
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)) (Iso.refl _) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R')) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    show _ = _
    rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(relCurve C R, V))
        = CommRingCat.ofHom ((relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap R V) from rfl,
      Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm
  · have h : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).ge =
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appTop :=
      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
    rw [h]
    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm

/-- PROBE: the widened section-level keystone as a ring equivalence. -/
noncomputable def probe_relSectionsBaseChangeAff {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, V) ⊗[R] R' ≃+* Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  ((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct R Γ(relCurve C R, V) R').isoIsPushout _ _
    (probe_isPushout_algebraMap_relSections C R R' hV)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

end Probe3

10	
11	For the curve bundle `C` over a field `k` and a commutative `k`-algebra `R` (the affine
12	test ring), the landed `Over.sectionsBaseChange` identifies `Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] R` with
13	the sections of the relative curve `C_R := relCurve C R` over the preimage `V_R` — but
14	only as a *ring* equivalence. This file threads the `R`-module structures through it,
15	once, and builds the comparison morphism between relative curves over a change of test
16	ring `R → R'`:
17	
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul_overAlgebraMap` — **the
19	  `R`-linear threading lemma**: the base-change equivalence carries `1 ⊗ r` to the
20	  structure pullback `overAlgebraMap R _ r` of `r` along `C_R ⟶ Spec R`. Definitional
21	  once both sides are put in `appLE` normal form.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsBaseChange` — **sections of the relative curve are the
23	  free base change**: `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)` as an `R`-linear
24	  equivalence (`R` acting on the left tensor factor and through `Scheme.overModule` on
25	  the right), with the computation rule `relSectionsBaseChange_tmul`.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relCurveMap` — the comparison morphism `C_{R'} ⟶ C_R` over a
27	  `k`-algebra map `R → R'` (the whiskering of `Spec` of the algebra map), with its
28	  projection identities `relCurveMap_fst`, `relCurveMap_snd` and the preimage identity
29	  `relCurveMap_preimage`.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap` — the induced ring homomorphism
31	  `Γ(C_R, V_R) →+* Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with its three governing identities: it commutes
32	  with the curve pullbacks (`relSectionsMap_pullback`), it intertwines the structure
33	  actions along `algebraMap R R'` (`relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`, whence the
34	  semilinearity `relSectionsMap_smul`), and it commutes with restriction
35	  (`relSectionsMap_resHom`).
36

38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeH1BaseChange`.

91	  rw [Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]
92	  rfl
93	
94	/-- **Sections of the relative curve are the free base change of the curve's sections**:
95	the `R`-linear equivalence `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V_R)`, for a qcqs
96	open `V ⊆ C.left`. The underlying map is the landed ring equivalence
97	`Over.sectionsBaseChange` (composed with the flip of the tensor factors); the `R`-module
98	structure on the right is `Scheme.overModule` for the structure morphism to `Spec R`. -/
99	noncomputable def relSectionsBaseChange
100	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
101	    R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R]
102	      Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) where
103	  toFun x := Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV' (TensorProduct.comm k R Γ(C.left, V) x)
104	  invFun y := (TensorProduct.comm k R Γ(C.left, V)).symm
105	    ((Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').symm y)
106	  left_inv x := by
107	    simp only [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
108	  right_inv y := by
109	    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
110	  map_add' x y := by rw [map_add, map_add]
111	  map_smul' r x := by
112	    rw [RingHom.id_apply]
113	    induction x with
114	    | zero => simp only [smul_zero, map_zero]
115	    | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, smul_add]
116	    | tmul a s =>
117	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
118	        TensorProduct.comm_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul,
119	        Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
120	      exact mul_left_comm _ _ _
121	
122	/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `a ⊗ s` goes to the structure
123	pullback of `a` times the pullback of `s` along the first projection (equivalently,
124	by `Scheme.overModule_smul_def`, to the `Scheme.overModule` action of `a` on the
125	pullback of `s`). -/
126	lemma relSectionsBaseChange_tmul
127	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
128	    (a : R) (s : Γ(C.left, V)) :
129	    relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV' (a ⊗ₜ s) =
130	      (relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap R ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) a *
131	        relPullbackSection C R V s := by
132	  change Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV'
133	    (TensorProduct.comm k R Γ(C.left, V) (a ⊗ₜ s)) = _
134	  rw [TensorProduct.comm_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul]
135	  exact mul_comm _ _

137	end Threading
